BluntPayload.description:
Berth closures the bang baseline would have asked for on the same seeded contact
stream (WO-050). Counterfactual: the approvals are assumed, nothing here happened.
BluntPayload.title: BluntPayload

EvidenceRow.description: One row per (contact, feature, source, tick). Immutable; ``row_id`` is its content hash.
EvidenceRow.title: EvidenceRow

FeatureName.description:
The 32 SPEC-INVESTIGATION section 2 features in section 2 order, then 5 support names
and 3 WO-088 responder outputs.
FeatureName.title: FeatureName

InvestigationStepPayload.description:
One planner choice of an investigation (runner v2 inside runner v3).

``source`` is where the choice came from: ``deterministic`` (no model), ``llm`` (a
model reply that passed the guard) or ``fallback`` (the model path was refused or
missed, so the deterministic choice stands; ``fallback_reason`` says why). The event is
sent at ``landed_tick``, after the rows the probe produced (``row_ids``).
InvestigationStepPayload.title: InvestigationStepPayload

LadderActionPayload.description:
One action the ladder executed (WO-043 driver), with the clause it rests on.

``clause`` is ``standing_orders.<rung>.<action>`` for an advisory or a hold (the
standing orders' signer in ``signed_by``), ``approval.<action>`` for an approved action.
``timeout_s``/``expires_t_s`` are set for an approval request or a backup page.
LadderActionPayload.title: LadderActionPayload

LadderState.description: SPEC-LADDER section 1. After HANDED_OFF only watching and departure exist.
LadderState.title: LadderState

LedgerBucket.description: Where a contact sits on the rung ledger: the bucket of its max rung so far.
LedgerBucket.title: LedgerBucket

LedgerPayload.description:
Contacts per ledger bucket so far (each contact once, at its max rung) and the
blunt counter. Display only: nothing reads it back into the ladder.
LedgerPayload.title: LedgerPayload

LostVehicleNotice.description: Sent to the plan's ``contact_channel``; the watch officer is not interrupted.
LostVehicleNotice.title: LostVehicleNotice

NoticeLine.description: One line of a LOST_VEHICLE notice under a SPEC-LADDER section 6 name.
NoticeLine.title: NoticeLine

PositionFix.description: One position: a reading (or a fitted position) with its noise and source row.
PositionFix.title: PositionFix

ProjectionEllipse.description:
Position uncertainty ellipse: semi-axes in metres, compass bearing of the major
axis in [0, 180), and the probability ``p`` it encloses.
ProjectionEllipse.title: ProjectionEllipse

ProjectionView.description: JSON-ready projected track of one contact at its last reading (for WO-086).
ProjectionView.title: ProjectionView

RecommendationPayload.description:
The frozen end of an investigation (WO-033 ``Recommendation``). The rung is computed
from the outcome by the investigation machine; nothing downstream can edit it.
RecommendationPayload.title: RecommendationPayload

ResponderPayload.description:
The harbor's responder at this tick (CLAUDE.md section 8 A2): a mobile probe that is
dispatched to look, holds station at standoff and returns to dock. Display only: no
field here can dispatch, position or recall it.
ResponderPayload.title: ResponderPayload

SearchBox.description: A circle (``center``, ``radius_m``) with its bounding box, for a LOST_VEHICLE notice.
SearchBox.title: SearchBox

SensorRangeRow.description: One hydrophone node's ring: the passive-sonar p = 0.5 range at its current noise.
SensorRangeRow.title: SensorRangeRow

SensorRangesPayload.description:
Every node's ring, sent every tick after the ``tick`` event, sorted by node id
(simulated physics, ``config/physics.yaml`` demo values; a vessel transit raises NL and
shrinks the ring).
SensorRangesPayload.title: SensorRangesPayload

SitrepPayload.description:
A SITREP. Part A streams the runner v1 LOST_VEHICLE notice as ``kind=lost_vehicle``;
the WO-042 ``Sitrep`` arrives in ``sitrep`` with ``kind=sitrep`` (Part B).
SitrepPayload.title: SitrepPayload
